title: Sebastian and the Portrait
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Rosalind Dunmore, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
